Description: Schema for HR administrators to review AI-classified employee requests and verify extracted information before automated response.

inputs.name: EmployeeEmailAddress
inputs.description: The email address of the employee who submitted the request.

inputs.name: DetectedRequestCategory
inputs.description: The category of the employee request as classified by AI (e.g., Leave Request, Expense Query, HR Policy Query, Other).

inputs.name: ExtractionStatus
inputs.description: The status of the information extraction process (e.g., Success, Pending, Employee Not Found).

inputs.name: AICategoryExplanation
inputs.description: A brief explanation from the AI regarding why the request was classified into its detected category.

inputs.name: ExtractedEmployeeData
inputs.description: Structured data extracted by the AI relevant to the employee request.

properties.name: EmployeeId
properties.description: The unique identifier for the employee.

properties.name: LeaveBalanceDays
properties.description: The employee's current leave balance in days.

properties.name: ExpenseReportStatus
properties.description: The current status of the employee's expense report.

properties.name: PolicyName
properties.description: The name of the relevant HR policy.

properties.name: PolicySummary
properties.description: A summary of the relevant HR policy details.

properties.name: OtherRelevantData
properties.description: Any additional extracted data not covered by specific fields.

outputs.name: ReviewerComment
outputs.description: Optional notes or feedback provided by the HR reviewer regarding the request.

outcomes.name: ApproveResponse
outcomes.description: Confirms that the extracted information is correct and allows the automation workflow to generate and send the final email reply.

outcomes.name: RejectResponse
outcomes.description: Indicates that the AI-generated extraction or classification is incorrect.

outcomes.name: ManualHandlingRequired
outcomes.description: Routes the request for manual HR intervention when the system cannot confidently process the request.

name: ActionSchema
